reason: The README describes an agent orchestration plugin that delegates bounded, read-only expert consultations to the Claude Code CLI through configurable roles and parallel panels, with runtime settings and status tracking.

summaries.zh: 通过可配置的顾问、审查者和设计师角色调用 Claude Code CLI，为智能体提供受约束的外部专家咨询与并行会诊。
summaries.en: Provides configurable advisor, reviewer, and designer roles that invoke the Claude Code CLI for bounded external expert consultations and parallel panels.

capabilities: Invokes the Claude Code CLI headlessly for expert consultations
Sends structured questions and labeled evidence to configured consultation roles
Supports parallel consultation panels and configurable model, effort, timeout, and fallback settings
Provides a settings workspace, consultation status previews, and session-scoped usage controls
